Guide

Category C vs Category C+E

Category C and Category C+E are both goods-vehicle entitlements. One is the rigid lorry. The other adds a trailer. They are trained and tested separately.

On this page

  1. What Category C covers
  2. What Category C+E adds
  3. Which one comes first

What Category C covers

A rigid goods vehicle over 3.5 tonnes that is not articulated. The cab and the body are on one chassis. If you are moving up from a car licence, this is the usual first lorry entitlement.

  • Category C training

What Category C+E adds

A trailer. That includes an articulated lorry, where the trailer attaches through a fifth wheel, and a drawbar outfit, where a rigid lorry tows a trailer. Coupling, uncoupling and reversing with the trailer are the practical difference.

  • Category C+E training

Which one comes first

Category C is the usual entitlement held before C+E training. If you do not hold Category C yet, start there. If you already hold it and the job needs a trailer, look at C+E.

On this site, Category C is listed at all three example bases. Category C+E is listed at Bristol and Exeter, not at Taunton.

Related

Courses

  • Category CPractical training for rigid goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes, for drivers moving up from a car licence.
  • Category C+ETrailer training for drivers who already hold Category C and need the articulated or drawbar entitlement.

Guides

  • Which HGV licence do I need?The licence depends on the vehicle you want to drive, and on what you already hold. This guide separates the main goods-vehicle entitlements from Driver CPC. It does not confirm that you qualify.
  • What happens on an HGV driving test?The practical test checks that you can control the vehicle and drive it on the road. The detail is set by DVSA and can be updated, so treat this as an outline and check the official description before test day.
  • How HGV training worksHGV training is a sequence, not a single lesson. You say what you want to drive, the licence you already hold is checked, and the medical, theory and practical steps are planned around that. No duration is stated here.

Ask about training

If you know which course you need, say so. If you are not sure, say that too.
